shots.title: Cold open: the wand places the car
shots.action: Tap the wand on flat ground: the ghost car appears, then the solid car.

framing.16:9: Car centred, hand and wand at the lower right.
framing.9:16: Car in the lower third, sky above.

shots.title: Drive past the camera and climb a kerb
shots.action: Drive the car forward past a fixed camera and over a one-block kerb without stopping.

framing.16:9: Fixed wide shot, the car crosses left to right.
framing.9:16: Fixed shot from the kerb, the car comes toward the lens.

shots.title: Cockpit view
shots.action: Sit in the car, switch to the cockpit view with hotbar slot 9 and steer a gentle curve.

framing.16:9: Full view out of the windscreen.
framing.9:16: Centre crop on the road ahead and the dashboard.

shots.title: Walk up and tap the door
shots.action: Walk up to the door kit and tap it once: the door swings open.

framing.16:9: Door at the right third, the player's hand tapping it.

shots.title: Sit on the seat kit
shots.action: Walk to the seat and tap it; the player sits and the view turns third person.

framing.16:9: Seat and player centred with the room behind.

shots.title: Size the car to 400 percent and drive it
shots.action: Place the car with the wand at 400 percent, board it and drive away from the camera.

framing.16:9: Wide chase, the player's own figure small beside the car.
framing.9:16: Low chase from behind, the car towering.

shots.title: Turntable under the end card
shots.action: Offline turntable of the car with the product name, the word Free and the unaffiliated disclaimer.
